result.summary: Found 1 visually broken area: the bottom navigation is overlapped by a dark system gesture bar/indicator, which makes the center tab look partially obscured and misaligned.

issues.description: The bottom navigation area is visually interfered with by a dark horizontal bar/gesture indicator, which cuts across the center of the nav and makes the middle icon look partially blocked.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area padding at the bottom and ensure the navigation bar sits above the system gesture area so none of the icons are obscured.
